messages:
zoe (partnerships): Proposal: "Orbit" SI Onramp pilot. 5-day sandbox, certification-lite, and a one-line marketplace listing template. Aim: get SIs to a customer demo in 5 days. Thoughts?
lee (solutions): Strong yes. Keep cohorts small (5-7). Two tracks: infra + app.
ana (training): I'll scope a 2-module cert + 1 practical (deploy + smoke test). Practical should be automatable.
tom (ops): We can do ephemeral sandboxes with capped GPU hours. Manual provisioning for cohort 1; automation later. Need intake CSV.
mira (marketplace): YAML template: name, short_desc, supported_models, deploy_modes, quickstart_url, contact. Add verified-benchmarks flag.
ci-bot: CI pipeline queued: partners/orbit-onramp/docs -> preview
zoe (partnerships): HW partners: can we secure 4 stable nodes for demos? Will request a templated quote for the joint announcement.
lee (solutions): Include a fallback note: if dedicated capacity is busy, fallback to hosted quantized variant. Document expected p95 examples.
ana (training): Rubric: setup (40%), deploy (40%), demo recording (20%). Allow one reattempt within 7 days.
tom (ops): Intake fields: org, contact, cost_center, nda_required (bool). We'll require an NDA for customer workloads.
mira (marketplace): I'll draft the YAML and a 2-sentence blurb for marketing.
zoe (partnerships): Timeline: prep this week, run pilot next week. Owners: Ana cert, Tom provisioning, Mira listing, Lee SI list. Kickoff 15m Mon.
lee (solutions): I'll send SI invite list by EOD.
zoe (partnerships): Thanks all. :rocket:
